# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS

# Methicillin-SUSCEPTIBLE Staphylococcus aureus pneumonia (mec-A/C and MREJ not

# detected)

Duration of therapy 7-14 days.

[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h R](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h)

< OR >

[Nafcillin 2 gm IV q4h DI](psjizid-nafcillin-2gm-iv-q4h)

# Oral therapy (usually given after several days of intravenous therapy):

A patient who is substantially improved, without a fever for at least 2 days can

be treated with an oral agent to which the isolate is susceptible.

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h R](psjzid-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-q12h)

< OR >

[Minocycline 100 mg PO q12h DI](psjzid-minocycline-100mg-po-q12h)

# _________________________________________________________________

# Methicillin-RESISTANT or Susceptibilities Unknown Staphylococcus aureus (mec-A/C

# and MREJ detected)

In patients with MRSA pneumonia complicated by empyema, antimicrobial therapy

should be used in conjunction with drainage procedures.

Duration of therapy 7-14 days

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

< OR >

[Linezolid 600 mg IV q12h DI,O](psjizid-linezolid-600mg-iv-q12h)

# Oral therapy (usually given after several days of intravenous therapy:

In cases when a patient has substantially improved and has not had a fever for

at least 2 days, it may be appropriate to treat with an oral agent to which the

isolate is susceptible to complete therapy.

[Minocycline 100 mg PO q12h DI](psjzid-minocycline-100mg-po-q12h)

< OR >

[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tab-bid)

< OR >

[Linezolid 600 mg PO q12h DI,O](psjzid-linezolid-600mg-po-q12h)
